## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] `gofmt`, `go vet` and the tests of the packages I touched pass; frontend changes pass `tsc` and `pnpm test`
- [ ] A new check, gap or failure is in `apps/desktop/wails/help/what-we-check.md`
- [ ] A change to a persisted file format updates `format-spec.md` and follows the schema migration policy
- [ ] Behaviour a user sees changes: the user guide is updated
- [ ] An entry in `docs/process/engineering-changelog.md`
- [ ] If this can turn a green run red for existing users, the description says so and how to adopt it gradually
